Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Name: Curved Lever on Long Plate (92 PZ)
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Description: Exterior door curved lever on a long narrow plate, 92 mm PZ. Plate 245 x 30 x 8, spindle 93 below the top, lever tip 113 from the spindle, 59 projection from the plate.
Na__Asset__Metadata.Na__Asset__Notes: Written by lever_asset_writer.py from the mcp-sketchup-3d-modeling-expert skill (learning/generators/door_furniture) on 2026-11-02. Sizes from HOPPE Atlanta 1530/3346 drawings. Authored lying on back like the Scroll (spindle +Z, Y up the door): builder applies X -90 lay-back plus CorrectionRotZ 180. ScaleX RH=-1 / LH=1 so the lever points at the hinge. OffsetX -60 is only read on interior doors, 60 in from the latch as their preview draws it: exterior placement uses HandleAbsoluteX. Plate is solid; the keyhole is a 2D shape 0.2 mm proud, whose edges carry EdgeColourId MTE105. All other edges take the builder's standard MTE103.

Na__Asset__Plan2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=towards the lever tip, Y=forward (away from door face) | Units=mm

Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0 = spindle centre. Front view of the outside plate.
Na__Asset__Elevation2D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: XY plane | X=towards the lever tip, Y=up | Units=mm

Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__OriginNote: Local 0,0,0 = spindle centre on the door face.
Na__Asset__Mesh3D.Na__Geometry__CoordSystem: Right-handed | X=towards the lever tip, Y=up the door, Z=out of the door | Units=mm
